itens.trecho: Verdadeiramente humano. Paul Edgecomb é um guarda prisional que trabalha na ala dos condenados, o "corredor da morte", de uma prisão do Sul dos EUA nos anos Trinta. Foi nessa prisão que ele conheceu John Coffey, um gigante negro acusado de violar e assassinar uma menina branca.

A Masterpiece of Cinematic Art -- Captivating and Reverent The head Death Row guard at a Tennessee prison during the Depression (Tom Hanks) observes a new inmate, a black man named John Coffey (Michael Clarke Duncan), who is condemned to death for the rape and murder of two little girls.

"Edgecomb" (Tom Hanks) is in charge of the prison officers who tend to the inmates on death row. He's a decent man who, with the help of his partner "Howell" (David Morse) tries to carry out his task as humanely as possible. Their team also numbers the truly odious "Percy" (Doug Hutchinson).
